Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Fell off motorcycle 2 months ago
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small shortly ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: T2 intermediate signal at the junction of the posterior horn and capsule contiguous with a linear signal within the posterior body consistent with a meniscocapsular injury and horizontal oblique undersurface tear of the horn.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete tear at the mid substance.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Low grade 2 sprain of the proximal medial collateral ligament with periligamentous edema.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 20 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Suspect remote pivot shift injury with:
1. Complete tear of the midsubstance of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2. Medial meniscus ramp lesion contiguous with an oblique undersurface tear in the body.
3. Low grade 2 sprain of the proximal medial collateral ligament

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Ön çapraz bağ sinyali miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder  artmıştır. Arka çapraz bağ tibia yapışma lokalizasyon komşuluğunda subkondral milimetrik kist izlenmiştir.Lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamaent çevresinde sıvı artışı izlendi(grade I sprain).Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta medial fasette  grade III kondromalazi lateral fasette  11x5 mm çapta subkondral defekt izlendi.Tibia medial platoda subkondral milimetrik  kistler izlendi.Suprapatellar reseste hafif sıvı artışları izlenmiştir.Diz eklemi oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler , eklem mesafesinde daralma mevcuttur. Ayrıca tibial ve femoral kartilajlarda yer yer hafif incelmeler izlendi(dejeneratif artrit bulguları izlendi.)Gastrocnemius medial crusunda tendonda tendinozis bulguları mevcuttur.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior horn düzeyinde evre 2 intra meniskal dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlenmiş olup medial menisküs laterale ekstrüdedir.Medial menisküs gövde-posterior horn düzeyinde kompleks yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm dikkati çekmektedir. Ayrıca medial menisküs posterior kesimde yırtık düzeyinde bütünlük kaybı yırtık lehinedir. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu kalınlaşma ve sinyal artımı izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Diz eklem aralığı ve suprapatellar bursada efüzyon mevcuttur.Diz eklem aralığı medial kompratmanda daha belirgin olmak üzere daralmış görünümde olup medial kompartmanda diz eklemi oluşturan kemik yapılarda kontüzyonel ödem dikkati çekti.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda yaygın dejeneratif sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Popliteal fossada yaklaşık 3 cm boyutunda baker kisti dikkati çekmiştir.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED]; intermittent, aching, pain with running. Playing golf. PT and ortho suspect meniscus injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. There is reactive bone marrow edema along the medial tibial plateau (series 5 image #17). Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex, predominantly oblique, tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a small fragment extending to the meniscotibial recess (series 5 image #14).  
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellar cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
Trochlear cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Complex, predominantly oblique undersurface tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with a small meniscal fragment extending to the meniscotibial recess. Reactive bone marrow edema along the medial tibial plateau.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W



> Spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of knee and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at femoral trochlea and patella, reflecting osteoarthritis of knee 
> Interstitial increased signal of ACL & PCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of chondromalacia.
> Linear signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
> Mild subcutaneous edema and muscle edema over left lower thigh to proximal leg.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee with grade 3-4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint.
2. Mild synovitis of left knee with medial and suprapatellar patellar plicae.
3. Degeneration of ACL and PCL.
4. Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
5. Subcutanoeus edema and muscle edema over left lower thigh to proximal leg.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Menisküs mediale doğru hafif ekstrüde görünümdedir.Ön çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresi ödemli izlendi(grade I sprain).Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde diz eklem aralığında daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda hafif incelmeler izlenmiştir.Diz eklemi bölgesinde komşu cilt altı yumuşak doku yağlı planlarında ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.

MRI Side  KNEE:

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

There is focal fissuring of the articular cartilage of the patella at the apex and particularly involving the medial facet. The finding is associated with subcortical interosseous edema and cyst formation within the patella. The articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea also demonstrates focal chondral fissuring at the trochlear apex with subcortical interosseous cyst formation also seen to the femoral trochlea.

No significant osteophytes are seen to the patellofemoral joint.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained overall.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are intact and appear unremarkable.

There is no evidence of significant Baker's cyst or knee effusion.

INTERPRETATION: 

There is severe articular chondrosis of the patellofemoral joint associated with early evolving degenerative change in the patellofemoral joint compartment.

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for several months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Mild reactive subchondral bone marrow edema at the weightbearing aspect of the medial compartment near the medial joint line. Medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartment marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn with dominant radial component at the posterior horn. Superior displacement of a meniscal flap at the posterior horn. Displacement of a meniscal flap into the tibiomeniscal recess. Severe meniscal body extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade articular cartilage loss of the weightbearing aspect of the joint with confluent areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity and diffuse low grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint with areas of high-grade fissuring.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Confluent full-thickness cartilage loss throughout the patella with subchondral signal changes. Diffuse high-grade articular cartilage loss of the trochlea with regions of full-thickness loss.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No lateral patellar tilt. Mild lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 18 mm, borderline elevated.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Severe patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartment osteoarthritis. Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn with dominant radial component at the posterior horn. Superior displacement of a small meniscal flap at the posterior horn-root junction. Severe meniscal extrusion.
2.	Moderate knee joint effusion. Moderate leaking Baker's cyst.
